messages:
maria: quick heads-up, opened a small docs PR for the Optimize toolkit. it's focused on migration examples for batching + prefix caching and clarifying quantization profile recommendations. PR: https://github.com/redwood/rdw-docs/pull/624
kevin: thanks — skimmed. looks good overall. one ask: can we add a brief example showing the impact on tail latency for small requests (seq len ~64)?
sophia: i can add a tiny benchmark table if you want. do we want synthetic numbers or point to the runtime perf dashboard?
maria: synthetic is fine for the guide — just illustrative. keep numbers obvious (e.g., 10ms -> 8ms). also need an SDK snippet update for the python client using the new `batching.config` field.
kevin: snippet idea:```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client()
resp = cli.generate("hello", batching={"max_batch_size":8, "idle_ms":10})
```
maria: perfect — i'll paste that. raj can you confirm wording for "quantization profile" section? we previously recommended 4-bit for cost but had edge cases for grammar in long sequences.
raj: yes — suggest: "start with 8-bit for safety, then test 4-bit with eval prompts; use quant-profile `conservative` for critical text gen routes." also call out `fallback_model` policy if quality regresses.
sophia: small nit: link to the Optimize toolkit config schema is broken in the PR. it points to /docs/old-optimize-config.md — should point to /docs/optimize/toolkit-config.md.
ci-bot: build status: docs lint passed; link-check failed on 1 URL -> https://github.com/redwood/rdw-docs/blob/main/docs/old-optimize-config.md
maria: thanks ci-bot. i'll update the link now. after that can we land once kevin or sophia approves?
kevin: i'm happy to approve after the benchmark table and SDK snippet are in. if maria adds those in one commit i'll review by EOD.
sophia: i'll do a pass for wording & accessibility (short bullets, callouts for SLO impact). small checkbox: add a short example config for prefix caching TTL:```yaml
cache:
  prefix_ttl_ms: 300000
  enabled: true
```
maria: adding both TTL example + brief bench numbers. will push an amend with PR comment describing changes. thanks all! :tada:
kevin: :thumbsup:
raj: :rocket:
